text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-48291 fired for service=inf-queue-provisioning (severity=high). queue_length=12300, provisioning_latency_p95=180s (>SLO 30s). runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/provision-slowdown

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident auto-created and notified on-call.

jamie: ack — I'm taking. jumping in to triage now. :eyes:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident acknowledged by jamie.

jamie: quick notes so ppl have context: autoscaler has been seeing a lot of ProvisionRequestFailed errors to the cloud provider for last 7m. nodes remain in PROVISIONING state, not reaching ready. backlog ~12.3k requests. 5xx rate creeping ~3%.

anil: on it — looking at autoscaler logs. can someone check nodepool quotas? suspect quota exhaustion or provider rate limits.

jamie: running quick checks:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep autoscaler
kubectl logs deploy/autoscaler -n inference --since=10m | tail -n 200
gcloud compute reservations list --filter=\"name:inference-*\"
```

jamie: logs show repeated: \"ProvisionRequestFailed: QuotaExceeded: CPUs\" and \"RateLimitExceeded\" backoff attempts. autoscaler retries but never completes.

sofia: I'm heading in as L2 — paging in. I've dm'd cloud-ops and opened provider ticket.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Escalation -> L2 alerted (sofia) after 4m.

sofia: plan: 1) verify provider quota 2) enable fallback pool (non-spot) 3) route low-priority traffic to standby model variant to reduce pressure.

rachel: provider ticket #CS-9876 opened (support link). Requested immediate quota lift for region us-west2. Meanwhile enabling fallback pool via infra CLI.

sofia: running manual spin-up of fallback instances (non-spot):
```bash
./infra/instances spinup --pool fallback-warm --count 6 --type c4-standard
```

jamie: tried manual safe-scale on inference-hot but hit provider 429 rate limit: `./infra/safe-scale --pool inference-hot --count +8` returned \"RateLimitExceeded\".

anil: changing strategy — deploying request-splitter to shed non-critical traffic and reduce queue pressure. pushing patch to prod now. this should buy ~2-4m if it deploys cleanly.

sofia: Patch applied; monitoring queue drain. queue_length now 11,200 (down ~1.1k) after reroute. good sign.

jamie: customer-impact check: from metrics, ~3% error rate, ~12% of requests >10s latency, a handful of customers (2 enterprise customers) seeing increased timeouts on batch endpoints. Logged in ops notes.

rachel: notifying CS/AE on impacted customers with initial template. ETA for full resolution depends on provider quota; still waiting on support.

anil: autoscaler logs show stuck work item: \"ProvisionRequest 0x3b failed with RateLimitExceeded\" repeated. I'm restarting autoscaler to clear stuck queue: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/autoscaler -n inference`

jamie: restart in progress. watch logs for retries.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Note — incident has been acknowledged and is in active mitigation.

sofia: cloud-ops replied: temporary quota bump approved for us-west2, ~+32 CPUs. they also suggested using fallback pool.

jamie: after quota bump, manual scale succeeded: `infra.safe-scale` returned success, 6 nodes became ready within 90s. queue draining faster. backlog now 5.4k.

anil: autoscaler restarted and reconciled; it now shows healthy provision requests. will leave autoscaler running but change operator throttle to reduce burst sensitivity: `kubectl patch deployment/autoscaler -n inference --patch \"{\\\"spec\\\":{\\\"template\\\":{\\\"spec\\\":{\\\"containers\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"autoscaler\\\",\\\"env\\\":[{\\\"name\\\":\\\"PROVISION_THROTTLE\\\",\\\"value\\\":\\\"0.7\\\"}]}]}}}}\"`

sofia: monitoring — queue down to 2.1k, 95th latency back to ~28s. error rate trending down.

jamie: taking notes for postmortem: root cause appears to be a combination of provider-side quota exhaustion and our autoscaler not handling provider rate-limit retries gracefully (excessive retry backoff + stuck in PROVISIONING).

rachel: filed incident ticket and assigned follow-up to infra team to add better guardrails and fallback automation.

sofia: handing off to anil for after-hours watch. anil — summary for you: actions taken, provider quota raised, fallback pool enabled, autoscaler restarted, temporary request-shedding deployed. watch queue and metrics for 1h, escalate back if queue >3k or errors >1%.

anil: ack, taking over. will monitor and escalate if anything regresses. I'll follow up with a short incident summary and recommended follow-ups for the writeup.

jamie: thanks all — logging final notes and closing active PD alert now that mitigation is in place. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident status updated -> Mitigated by jamie (acknowledged) and sofia (L2).

incident-bot: Incident thread created at 1738889999, handoff complete.
